Resolver.SourceUrl: Nautilus-DLIllustr is the internal Delaware Life / Group 1001 Nautilus product line of the illustration tool, with no public download URL. Obtain the current 'Nautilus-DLIllustr v<version>.msi' from the internal software distribution share and stage it in the package Files folder.

Installation.OfflineFallback: Stage the installer in the package Files folder to bypass the download.

Provenance.Notes: OFFLINE-ONLY / INTERNAL. Nautilus variant of DLIllustr (separate product from the base PSADT.DLIllustr). Current staged media: 'Nautilus-DLIllustr v3.8.0.msi' - ProductName 'Nautilus-DLIllustr v3.8.0', ProductCode {95A90A7F-FA7D-4E04-B06F-6B6EE432744F}, UpgradeCode {05B7485E-D6EE-4E89-AE77-E8A26E73B617} (shared with base DLIllustr), Manufacturer 'Delaware Life', v3.8.0. InstallShield MSI, installs silently with ALLUSERS=1. ProductName embeds the version so detection is '^Nautilus-DLIllustr v'. NOTE: this ProductCode {95A90A7F-...} is the same GUID the legacy.DL_illustr install script removed as a 'legacy InstallShield key' before installing the base product - so the two products historically conflicted. Pilot base + Nautilus together to confirm current coexistence/upgrade behaviour. For an exact-version gate in Intune use ProductCode {95A90A7F-FA7D-4E04-B06F-6B6EE432744F}. No public download URL - media must be staged in Files\.
